subject: SIG snapshot + scoped evidence mapping for onboarding tempo
messages:
From: Liam Shaw <liam.shaw@novumcloud.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: platform-security@novumcloud.com
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick SIG snapshot to unblock Redwood onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick chat earlier. As discussed, we're trying to provide a compact SIG snapshot that maps only the signals you require for initial risk review — nothing exhaustive yet.

Attached I sent a CSV that maps our internal control IDs to the SIG questionnaire fields (sig-field-map-v1.csv). We can also produce a short package with the SOC 2 evidence pointers (hosted links + short descriptions) if that helps.

Two asks from our side that would unblock us:
- A short list (10–15) of SIG questions you need answered for provisioning access in Whistic.
- Confirmation whether temporary API keys for bulk evidence upload are acceptable (we'd rotate after onboarding).

Proposed next step: 30-min working call this afternoon to align the minimal set and token expiry policy.

Best,
Liam
Security Engineer 
NovumCloud

Attachments: sig-field-map-v1.csv (CSV mapping), requested-evidence-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Shaw <liam.shaw@novumcloud.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick SIG snapshot to unblock Redwood onboarding

Thanks Liam — appreciate the mapping. Forwarding to our intake squad.

Jonas / Ben — can you review Liam's CSV and suggest the short SIG subset we should request? High-level constraints:
- Keep initial questions to those that directly affect access (auth, data encryption in transit, key management, incident notification).
- Prefer links to evidence (S3 presigned URLs / Whistic attachments) over large file uploads.
- Accept ephemeral API token for the bulk upload, but require a maximum TTL of 7 days and a post-upload rotation.

Ben: can your team confirm whether a 7-day TTL + documented rotation procedure is sufficient for our vendor onboarding policy? If not, propose alternatives.

Irene

Signature:
Irene Choi
Sr. Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Shaw <liam.shaw@novumcloud.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick SIG snapshot to unblock Redwood onboarding

Irene — quick read of the CSV: neat mapping, thanks. My proposed minimal SIG subset (I numbered them to make it easy to reference):
1) AuthN/AuthZ (SSO, MFA, service account controls)
2) TLS in transit for all control-plane and data-plane endpoints
3) Customer key management for at-rest encryption (KMS usage + rotation cadence)
4) Production logging retention and access controls (who can export logs)
5) Incident detection and notification SLA (time to acknowledge + time to notify customers)
6) Change control for privileged access (approval and audit evidence)
7) Third-party subprocessor list and data residency commitments
8) Backup encryption and recovery testing cadence
9) Vulnerability disclosure and patching cadence
10) Evidence pointers for SOC 2 report sections (links + page refs)

On the token: 7 days TTL is acceptable if Novum provides a short rotation playbook and we receive a signed attestation when the token is revoked. We'll accept Whistic attachments or presigned object links.

I'll join the 30-min call and can bring a short checklist PDF (requested-evidence-checklist.pdf).

Ben

Ben Carter
Security & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Liam Shaw <liam.shaw@novumcloud.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick SIG snapshot to unblock Redwood onboarding

Thanks all — summary and action items from our side:
- Redwood asks the 10-question SIG minimum Ben proposed. Liam — please mark which rows in your CSV correspond to the numbered items and push back if any are impossible within two business days.
- Novum to generate ephemeral API token for Whistic upload: TTL=7 days, scope=attachments:create, evidence:put; include rotation steps and a single-line signed attestation when rotated.
- Novum to upload the 10 evidence items as Whistic attachments or presigned links and add comments linking to SOC 2 report pages where applicable.
- Tentative working call set for 16:30 PT — agenda: align mapping, confirm token flow, agree on attestation wording.

Liam — see you on the call. If you prefer, we can pivot to a 20-min async checklist review and postpone the call.

Jonas

Jonas Weber
Vendor Security Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
